findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agents" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_endpoint_history · Private data: query_agent_index, get_endpoint_history, export_agent_index, bulk_agent_index, scan_agent_package · Public sink: scan_agent_package · Destructive: export_agent_index, scan_agent_package.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_endpoint_history · Private data: query_agent_index, get_endpoint_history, export_agent_index, bulk_agent_index, scan_agent_package · Public sink: scan_agent_package · Destructive: export_agent_index, scan_agent_package

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
